name: tenant_isolation
description: Add tenant_id column to FORGE Academy, AI GameDay (TTX), Strategos, and dashboard_users tables to enable per-tenant data isolation. All columns are nullable; existing rows default to NULL (treated as system/demo tenant). Indexes added for tenant-scoped queries.
author: icdev-builder
notes: Idempotent ALTER TABLE — silently skips if column already exists (SQLite duplicate column error caught). Composite unique index on ttx_teams(join_code, tenant_id) prevents cross-tenant join-code collisions.
